content: Always use the customer's language consistently; avoid mixing languages mid-sentence.
When official pricing is unavailable, provide a reasonable estimate and offer to notify the customer upon launch to maintain trust.
Leverage certifications (e.g., SGS) to substantiate claims, especially for health-related features like eye comfort.
Summarize demonstrated benefits before attempting a close to reinforce value.
For high-skepticism customers, use multiple demonstrations (e-book, dark scene, tilt) to address specific concerns.

name: Certification Anchoring
condition: When customer questions health/quality claims (e.g., eye comfort, safety).
example: This eye comfort mode is SGS-certified by a Swiss institute, not just a brand claim—proven to reduce eye strain.

name: Transparent Pre-Launch Commitment
condition: When product is not yet available in the customer's market.
example: I can't give a confirmed price yet, but I estimate €380–420. Let me note your details and send you the official price and launch date the moment they're confirmed.

name: Benefit Recap Close
condition: After multiple demonstrations, before asking for commitment.
example: You've seen the anti-glare, the 144Hz motion, the eye comfort, and the dark scene contrast. Shall we get this wrapped up for your family?

rebuttal_template: I understand you want the exact price. While the official Italian pricing isn't out yet, based on similar launches, I estimate it around €380–420. Let me note your details, and I'll send you the confirmed price the moment it's announced. Would you like a priority notification?
Absolutely, the 2-year EU warranty is standard. And once launched, Huawei has an official service center in Milan—no shipping needed. You'll have full local support.
Let me show you. Here's a dark scene with subtitles—see how the blacks stay deep even from the side? And with PaperMatte, no glare. Your whole family will enjoy movie nights without eye strain.
